stations.title: Shop screen
stations.text: The discount is passed through every part.
stations.note: A new shelf forgot to pass it on.

captions: At the gift shop till, Anjali wants every member to get the member price.
A member buys a book, and the new shelf never got the discount handed down to it.
You give the discount a context of its own and provide it once, in four tasks.
The member pays the member price on every shelf, and vouchers stay at full price.
Same shop, no discount passed by hand. A new shelf can never forget it again.
